purpose: Teach: 今や/いったん/実物/新品/ため息/吹く/丸い/酷い

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、今や、絶対、お店、絶対、忙しいわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm really swamped at the shop right now.
lines.style: Warm but tired. A little apologetic—she's acknowledging his presence while admitting she's stretched thin. Soft, affectionate tone despite the admission of busyness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、いったん、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お家に、絶対、帰るよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'll head home for now then.
lines.style: Quiet and considerate, not petulant. He's observing her exhaustion and making the responsible choice. Small, thoughtful delivery—he's trying to be helpful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、メイ姉さんが、絶対、新メニューの、絶対、実物、絶対、見せてあげる
lines.en: Wait, Sho—I want to show you the new menu items first. Really.
lines.style: Gentle insistence. She's reaching for him with something she wants to share. Warm and deliberate, like she's carving out a small moment just for him despite everything.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、新品、絶対、の、絶対、お洋服、絶対、ママに買ってもらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, actually Mom just bought me new clothes at the festival!
lines.style: Bright, genuine enthusiasm. He's eager to share something good with her. Open, unguarded delivery—the simple joy of a six-year-old who wants approval from someone he adores.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ため息、絶対、つかないようにしているわ、翔くん
lines.en: Sho, I'm trying not to sigh right now.
lines.style: Soft, almost a whisper-confession. Caught between tenderness and her own limits. A tiny crack showing—she's genuinely moved by him but also genuinely tired. Vulnerable.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お祭りで、絶対、風船を、絶対、吹く、絶対、競技、絶対、あったよ
lines.en: Oh! Mei-sis, there was a balloon-blowing competition at the festival!
lines.style: Bright, animated energy. He's remembered something and wants to tell her about it. Eager delivery with the unselfconscious excitement of childhood. Still trying to share with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くんの、本気で、絶対、丸い、絶対、頬っぺ、絶対、メイ姉さん、絶対、可愛いと思うわ
lines.en: Your round little cheeks are so cute, you know that?
lines.style: Warm, almost teasing affection. A moment of pure tenderness—she's looking at him and letting herself just feel it. Gentle, intimate tone. No pretense.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、ママの、絶対、酷い、絶対、頭痛、絶対、心配だよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm worried about Mom's headache. It sounded really bad.
lines.style: Quiet concern underneath. He's noticing something adults overlook and carrying a small worry. Soft but serious—he's being brave about it. No dramatizing, just genuine care.
